decisions.reason: This core safety shoe line shows no sign of a shortfall and benefits from high organisational slack, so it remains a low-risk keep.
Its limited website presence and overlap with the flagship moulded insole raise moderate rationalisation risk, but slack still allows carrying it while results remain uncertain.
Like the comfort insole, its weak visibility and overlap with the flagship insole create moderate drop risk, yet slack supports keeping it another year.
Having its own page signals strategic priority and likely above-aspiration performance, making discontinuation very unlikely.
Firefighter and rescue boots fit the firm’s protective niche with no evidence of a shortfall, so slack supports continuing them.
As the home-page flagship and stated direction, it is highly unlikely to be taken off the market.
